title: Beethoven — Für Elise, WoO 59 (Mutopia typeset)

reference.license: Public Domain (Mutopia 2015/08/18-931, Stelios Samelis after Breitkopf & Härtel 1888). reference.sha256 pins the bare Mutopia .mid at reference.url (fetch copies it into the midi dir; there is no archive).

editionNotes: Same musical text as the `fur-elise` pin, but the PDF is the Mutopia LilyPond typeset at reference.url's sibling — so PDF, MIDI and .ly all come from one source and the whole entry is fetchable. `fur-elise` keeps the IMSLP scan for the hosted-vs-local shootout; do not cross the two.
LilyPond \tempo 4 = 72 under a transparent MetronomeMark; the printed heading is 'Poco moto.' in 3/8 with a one-eighth pickup (pickupQuarters 0.5).

performedBars 126 is derived from the Mutopia .ly at https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/BeethovenLv/WoO59/fur_Elise_WoO59/fur_Elise_WoO59.ly (sha256 828a7bd1b42e441fe1b0eb0389ba46f1502dab28bbe488389e635fb446ba7a67), rendered with LilyPond 2.26.0 under \unfoldRepeats and bucketed by src/eval/midiRef.ts's own convention; the same render folded reproduces the pinned reference MIDI byte-for-byte (905 notes) and scores 105 bars = printedBars, and a hand-walk of the two \repeat volta 2 blocks agrees (repeat surplus 21).

Both bar pins use the MIDI-grid convention, not LilyPond's engraved numbering: the \alternative endings use \set Timing.measurePosition to borrow an eighth across the barline, so the engraved instance count is 106/127 against the pinned 105/126. That one-bar convention gap is pre-existing — it is why the bench records `printed-bar-count (106 printed bars read)`. The parser currently reads 106 printed but 126 performed (surplus 20 — the +1 printed-side split offset by a one-bar shortfall on the unfold side), so performedBarsMatch can read true while printed-bar-count still fails; printed-bar-count and bar-alignment stay the honest signal. Keeping both pins in one convention preserves the surplus of 21; do not 'fix' one pin without the other.
printedBars 105 is the uniform-3/8 bar count the MIDI produces (verify with `run` — refBars in the summary), not LilyPond's printed numbering, which the measurePosition borrowing shifts.
Do not embed document UUIDs. --from document cannot --out a baseline-* oracle.
No ornament signs (the \grace and \appoggiatura figures are ordinary notes in the reference MIDI), so expectedExtraNotes is 0.
